about: Bentonville City Square (1 E Central Ave, Bentonville AR) surveyed layout. Source of truth for src/world/bentonville-square/. Game metres in the composed map: x EAST, z SOUTH, y up, 1 m = 1 m (the Square tile is an unrotated real-map cut-out moved by tileOffset). Evidence and confidence: docs/square/source-index.md, docs/square/survey.csv, docs/square/accuracy-report.md.

anchor.note: Fountain centre. lat/lon derived from the game position through scripts/fetch-map-data.mjs projection (origin 36.3729, -94.2088; MX = 111320 cos(lat0), MZ = 110574) and the compose-map tile offset.

park.name: Bentonville City Square
park.note: Park polygon and every path inside it come from OpenStreetMap (already in public/data/bentonville-osm.json). Verified against Esri World Imagery (Vantor GE01, 2025-09-27, 0.46 m).

fountain.conf: position verified (OSM ring way + Esri 2025 water ring); radii estimated from 0.46-0.6 m imagery; heights estimated (no measurements)

trees.note: Crown centres read from USDA NAIP (0.6 m) and corrected to the OSM / Esri frame (NAIP sits up to ~4 m south-east of both here: x += 0.1 (z + 2), z += 0.22 (z + 2)). Crown = radius in m. Species not identified. Trunks within 2 m of a park path are nudged off it at build time.

loot.note: Game-only spawns (not geography). The park is reserved, so generic loot stays out; these replace it.

missing: north block (NE 2nd St) 2026 status: shown standing per the latest dated imagery (2025-09-27); needs a dated 2026 photo
benches (City lists six; positions not resolvable in 0.46-0.6 m imagery)
lamps, trash cans, planters, bike racks inside the park
fountain water jets / exact basin profile
all four street-wall facades (buildings are still OSM/Overture extrusions)

buildings.note: Buildings the surveyed evidence shows but the OpenStreetMap extract lacks. Added to the map data by createSquare before buildings are raised (same builder, colliders and interiors as every other building).

list.conf: estimated: present in USDA NAIP and Esri World Imagery 2025-09-27 (large flat roof, ~2 storeys from shadow); not in OpenStreetMap (2026-11-19). South wall z -26.5 matches both; north wall -61 (NAIP) vs -72 (Esri), mean used. Hart on Main redevelopment site (announced 2026-02): status on 2026-11-19 NOT verified - replace if dated 2026 imagery shows demolition.
